about: Warfarin overlapped daily aspirin tablet fractions while peripheral arterial disease was stable, and the later aspirin supply for toothache does not count.

Possible finding: the record holds no line about coronary, cerebrovascular or peripheral arterial disease. Xarelto (rivaroxaban) and Plavix (clopidogrel) are both supplied eight times from November 2025.
Marevan (warfarin) and Cartia (aspirin) are both supplied, but the record shows a mechanical heart valve and says no coronary, cerebrovascular or peripheral arterial disease, so there is no finding.
